options.content: Meerut CBG · CBG · lab, feedstock form and statistics  ·  thin lines: daily values  ·  light blue dashed: calendar-month average (sensor charts: 30-day average)  ·  shaded bands: warning and limit  ·  red dots: outside the limit

panels.description: Daily values (thin line), each calendar month's average (thick blue, months with at least 3 values), and values outside the limit (red dots). Limits as dashed lines with shaded bands.

targets.rawSql: WITH s AS (SELECT ((x.date_fed_into_eq_tank AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata' AS time, 'Pressmud' AS metric, sum(x.pressmud_quantity)::numeric AS value FROM user_feedstockdata x JOIN user_customform f ON f.id = x.form_id WHERE f.team_id = 5 AND $__timeFilter(x.date_fed_into_eq_tank) GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT ((x.date_fed_into_eq_tank AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata' AS time, 'Cow manure' AS metric, sum(x.cow_manure_quantity)::numeric AS value FROM user_feedstockdata x JOIN user_customform f ON f.id = x.form_id WHERE f.team_id = 5 AND $__timeFilter(x.date_fed_into_eq_tank) GROUP BY 1) SELECT time, metric, value FROM s ORDER BY 1

WITH s AS (SELECT ((x.date_fed_into_eq_tank AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata' AS time, 'Pressmud' AS metric, sum(x.pressmud_quantity)::numeric AS value FROM user_feedstockdata x JOIN user_customform f ON f.id = x.form_id WHERE f.team_id = 5 AND $__timeFilter(x.date_fed_into_eq_tank) GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT ((x.date_fed_into_eq_tank AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata' AS time, 'Cow manure' AS metric, sum(x.cow_manure_quantity)::numeric AS value FROM user_feedstockdata x JOIN user_customform f ON f.id = x.form_id WHERE f.team_id = 5 AND $__timeFilter(x.date_fed_into_eq_tank) GROUP BY 1), m AS (SELECT time, value, date_trunc('month', time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata') AS mo FROM s), a AS (SELECT mo, avg(value) AS av, count(*) AS n FROM m GROUP BY mo)
SELECT time, "Monthly average" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT m.time, a.av AS "Monthly average" FROM m JOIN a ON a.mo = m.mo WHERE a.n >= 3 UNION ALL SELECT a.mo AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata', NULL::numeric FROM a WHERE a.mo AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata' > $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) x ORDER BY time

targets.rawSql: WITH s AS (SELECT (a.day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata') AS time, initcap(a.loc) AS metric, (a.v / NULLIF(b.v, 0))::numeric AS value FROM (SELECT lower(regexp_replace(btrim(l.location), '\s*:.*$', '')) AS loc, btrim(l.type_of_lab_test) AS t, (l.time_of_sample_collection AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date AS day, avg(l.result) AS v FROM user_labtestdata l JOIN user_customform f ON f.id = l.form_id WHERE f.team_id = 5 AND $__timeFilter(l.time_of_sample_collection) GROUP BY 1, 2, 3) a JOIN (SELECT lower(regexp_replace(btrim(l.location), '\s*:.*$', '')) AS loc, (l.time_of_sample_collection AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date AS day, avg(l.result) AS v FROM user_labtestdata l JOIN user_customform f ON f.id = l.form_id WHERE f.team_id = 5 AND btrim(l.type_of_lab_test) = 'Alkalinity' AND $__timeFilter(l.time_of_sample_collection) GROUP BY 1, 2) b ON b.loc = a.loc AND b.day = a.day WHERE a.t = 'Volatile Acids' AND a.loc IN ('digester 1','digester 2','digester 3','digester 4')) SELECT time, metric, value FROM s ORDER BY 1
